Ring of No Affinity.text: Affinity Rings are randomly generated as loot, and will boost the level of a select spell by one. This effect can stack. Spell can be set in the Arcane Anvil using a scroll.

Mithril Ore (Deepslate).text: Can be found below y = -38, unexposed to air. Requires a netherite pickaxe to harvest. Drops Raw Mithril

Acupuncture.text: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done

Blood Needles.text: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done

Blood Slash.text: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.

Blood Step.text: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

Devour.text: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.

Heartstop.text: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.

Raise Dead.text: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

Ray Of Siphoning.text: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

Wither Skull.text: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

Sacrifice.text: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

Counterspell.text: Interrupt player and mob casting Banishes summoned shield , blood slash , creeper head Banishes summoned creatures Removes root Removes mob effects like fortify or evasion

Dragon's Breath.text: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

Evasion.text: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

Magic Arrow.text: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.

Magic Missile.text: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.

Starfall.text: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

Teleport.text: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.

Summon Ender Chest.text: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.

Recall.text: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

Portal.text: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.

Echoing Strikes.text: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.

Black Hole.text: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

Summon Swords.text: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

Shadow Slash.text: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

Arcane Shackle.text: Hurl a bundle of arcane chains. Upon hitting a creature, cause three chains to bind it to the ground, each applying a tethering force. On miss, three chains lash out to unique nearby creatures. Chains can be damaged or dispelled.

Gravity Fissure.text: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.

Chain Creeper.text: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

Fang Strike.text: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.

Fang Ward.text: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.

Firecracker.text: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.

Gust.text: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall

Invisibility.text: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.

Lob Creeper.text: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

Shield.text: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.

Spectral Hammer.text: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.

Summon Horse.text: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.

Summon Vex.text: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.

Slow.text: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

Arrow Volley.text: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.

Throw.text: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

Fang Swirl.text: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.

Scapegoat.text: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.

Blaze Storm.text: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

Burning Dash.text: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.

Fireball.text: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.

Firebolt.text: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.

Fire Breath.text: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.

Magma Bomb.text: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

Wall Of Fire.text: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.

Heat Surge.text: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

Flaming Strike.text: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

Scorch.text: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

Flaming Barrage.text: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

Fire Arrow.text: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.

Raise Hell.text: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.

Angel Wings.text: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.

Blessing Of Life.text: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

Fortify.text: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

Greater Heal.text: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

Guiding Bolt.text: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

Healing Circle.text: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

Heal.text: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.

Sunbeam.text: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

Wisp.text: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

Divine Smite.text: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

Haste.text: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

Cleanse.text: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

Cone Of Cold.text: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.

Frost Step.text: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

Ice Block.text: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

Icicle.text: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.

Summon Polar Bear.text: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.

Ray Of Frost.text: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.

Frostwave.text: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

Ice Spikes.text: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

Ice Tomb.text: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.

Snowball.text: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

Frostbite.text: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

Blizzard.text: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.

Ascension.text: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

Chain Lightning.text: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

Charge.text: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

Electrocute.text: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.

Lightning Bolt.text: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.

Lightning Lance.text: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

Shockwave.text: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

Thunderstorm.text: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

Ball Lightning.text: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

Volt Strike.text: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.

Acid Spit.text: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor

Blight.text: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage

Poison Arrow.text: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact

Poison Spray.text: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach

Poison Splash.text: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud

Root.text: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement

Aspect Of The Spider.text: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

Firefly Swarm.text: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

Oakskin.text: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

Earthquake.text: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.

Stomp.text: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.

Gluttony.text: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

Touch Dig.text: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

Abyssal Shroud.text: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

Sculk Tentacles.text: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

Sonic Boom.text: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

Planar Sight.text: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

Telekinesis.text: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.

Pocket Dimension.text: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.
